evidence_quotes.O: You really need to read the instruction manual to get the most out of the camera - after reading it I discovered just how much I was missing!
evidence_quotes.C: It takes up little space on my bedside table, measuring 7.5" tall, 5.5" wide and 2.5" at its thickest point.
evidence_quotes.E: Six months later, I am still thrilled with the purchase.
evidence_quotes.A: This boombox is used as a radio/ipod player for my young son. I would not be happy with it but since it works for him, it's okay.
evidence_quotes.N: Taking it out the box, I noted scratches on the face but removing the thin and barely noticeable protective skin solved that issue.
